scope: Historical failures and mathematically unsuccessful reconstruction attempts. These entries are not successful PDE computations or continuous-error certificates.

entries.observed_outcome: The first P23 N1280 reference reached numerical output, but NPZ writing failed because the C volume was full.
entries.recovery: Complete same-setting computation was rerun in the authorized separate data volume; original partial files were retained.

entries.observed_outcome: P23 N2560 BDF failed at the 14400 s input knot with Required step size is less than spacing between numbers.
entries.recovery: Use local time tau=t-segment_start with the same physical RHS, grid, tolerances and every original breakpoint; successful local-clock references and complete output replays are separately recorded.

entries.observed_outcome: Early Q4 proof attempts encountered real NumPy allocation failures during repeated archive decompression; the reported requests were approximately 3.4 MiB and 1.58 MiB.
entries.recovery: Preload each small NPZ once, retaining the same interval mathematical kernel and proof constants; completed replacement certificates have independent completion flags.

entries.observed_outcome: The original Q4 N5120 local-clock attempt encountered a real SuperLU malloc failure while other large processes were active.
entries.recovery: Waited for available memory and performed one complete same-setting replay in global_local_clock_retry_01. No mesh, tolerance, input knot or output requirement was reduced.

entries.observed_outcome: A point enclosure for the P23 C1 Hermite reconstruction gave weighted residual approximately 1.1733e-5 per s, already above the attempted 1e-7 target. Subdividing intervals could not make this reconstruction meet that target.
entries.stopped_reason: Mathematical target disproved for this reconstruction by the point residual lower bound; the adaptive diagnostic was stopped for that reason, not to reduce a PDE computation's precision or cost.
entries.replacement: Unique C2 clamped spline with exact Robin slope, followed by outward direct/mean-value residual intersections. These new proof objects are independently defined and verified.

failure_message_provenance: Failures were observed in actual execution tool output; retained partial arrays and progress files are diagnostic context, not substitutes for a complete transcript or completion report.
unrelated_original_q1_or_2d_runs: Not evaluated by this endpoint ledger; their failure/recovery statuses are maintained by the parent task.
